XMLDB.COMMENT: Nucleus federation hub — tables for registered spokes, course-versioning draft/changelog state (ADR-014) and the sign-in provider (ADR-023).

TABLE.NAME: local_nucleushub_spokes
TABLE.COMMENT: Spokes registered with this federation hub. Phase 0 holds a single row, inserted manually; Phase 1 is populated by the control plane at spoke provisioning time.

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: Human-readable spoke name.

FIELD.NAME: wwwroot
FIELD.COMMENT: Spoke's wwwroot reachable from the hub.

FIELD.NAME: token
FIELD.COMMENT: Copy of the web service token this spoke calls the hub with: its own service account's token for the nucleus_federation service (ADR-023). Empty once the spoke is removed.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: active | suspended | removed

FIELD.NAME: cpspokeid
FIELD.COMMENT: Control-plane Spoke.id (cuid). Set at register_spoke time; used to address the spoke on outbound events without a name lookup. Phase B1.

FIELD.NAME: serviceuserid
FIELD.COMMENT: mdl_user.id of this spoke's own hub service account (ADR-023 section 6). Its token is the only one the spoke holds. Null for rows registered before per-spoke accounts, and once the spoke is removed.

TABLE.NAME: local_nucleushub_draft
TABLE.COMMENT: Hub-side tracking for the live draft of each course family: which Moodle course is the working copy, what the latest published version was, and how many unpublished edits have accumulated since then. Exactly one row per family (one-course model per ADR-014).

FIELD.NAME: familyid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_nucleuscommon_family.id. Unique — the one-course model pins a draft to one family.

FIELD.NAME: hubcourseid
FIELD.COMMENT: mdl_course.id of the working hub course. Unique — one course can back one family.

FIELD.NAME: lastpublishversionid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_nucleuscommon_version.id. Null if the family has never been published.

FIELD.NAME: pendingchangecount
FIELD.COMMENT: Changelog rows accumulated since the last publish. Resets to 0 on publish.

FIELD.NAME: timelastedit
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix time of the most recent edit event, for 'N minutes ago' banners.

TABLE.NAME: local_nucleushub_changelog
TABLE.COMMENT: Per-family accumulator of course-edit events since the last publish. Rolled up into the version's releasenotes summary on publish, then cleared. Populated by hooks into Moodle course/module/section/file events (see ADR-014 §Hub-side editing lifecycle).

FIELD.NAME: eventkind
FIELD.COMMENT: Normalised event name, e.g. 'module_added', 'module_updated', 'section_updated', 'file_replaced', 'course_updated'.

FIELD.NAME: objecttype
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional: 'cm', 'section', 'file', 'course' — the kind of thing the event targeted.

FIELD.NAME: objectid
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional: Moodle id of the targeted object (cm id, section id, etc.).

INDEX.NAME: family_time
INDEX.COMMENT: Listing a family's pending changes in chronological order.

TABLE.NAME: local_nucleushub_oidc_client
TABLE.COMMENT: Sign in with the hub (ADR-023 section 3): one OpenID Connect client per spoke. The secret is stored only as a SHA-256 hash.

FIELD.NAME: spokeid
FIELD.COMMENT: local_nucleushub_spokes.id. One client per spoke row.

FIELD.NAME: clientid
FIELD.COMMENT: Public client identifier. Stays the same when the client is registered again.

FIELD.NAME: secrethash
FIELD.COMMENT: Hex SHA-256 of the client secret (256 random bits, so no slow hash is needed). The secret itself is never stored.

FIELD.NAME: redirecturi
FIELD.COMMENT: The one redirect URI, compared exactly: {spoke wwwroot}/auth/nucleus/callback.php

FIELD.NAME: postlogouturi
FIELD.COMMENT: The one post-logout redirect URI, compared exactly: {spoke wwwroot}/

TABLE.NAME: local_nucleushub_oidc_code
TABLE.COMMENT: Sign in with the hub: authorisation codes. Single use, 60 seconds, stored only as a SHA-256 hash and bound to client, redirect URI, user, nonce and PKCE challenge.

FIELD.NAME: codehash
FIELD.COMMENT: Hex SHA-256 of the code. Replaced by a claim marker while the code is being redeemed.

FIELD.NAME: clientid
FIELD.COMMENT: local_nucleushub_oidc_client.clientid the code was issued to.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The hub user who signed in.

FIELD.NAME: redirecturi
FIELD.COMMENT: Redirect URI of the authorisation request. The token request must send the same.

FIELD.NAME: nonce
FIELD.COMMENT: The client's nonce, copied into the ID token.

FIELD.NAME: codechallenge
FIELD.COMMENT: PKCE S256 challenge: base64url(sha256(code_verifier)).

FIELD.NAME: authtime
FIELD.COMMENT: When the user signed in to the hub (auth_time claim).

TABLE.NAME: local_nucleushub_oidc_token
TABLE.COMMENT: Sign in with the hub: opaque access tokens for the userinfo endpoint. 300 seconds, stored only as a SHA-256 hash.

FIELD.NAME: tokenhash
FIELD.COMMENT: Hex SHA-256 of the access token.

FIELD.NAME: clientid
FIELD.COMMENT: local_nucleushub_oidc_client.clientid the token was issued to.

TABLE.NAME: local_nucleushub_oidc_subject
TABLE.COMMENT: Sign in with the hub: each hub user's opaque subject identifier (the sub claim). Random, never derived from the user id, so a reused user id can't inherit someone else's spoke accounts.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The hub user. One subject per user.

FIELD.NAME: sub
FIELD.COMMENT: 32 lowercase hex characters: bin2hex(random_bytes(16)).
